hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabee161a_featurestore --limit 0 "WITH base AS (SELECT t.row_id AS row_id, t.account_id AS account_id, t.event_time AS event_time, t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd, CASE WHEN (CAST(floor(t.event_time / 86400000) AS bigint) + 4) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend, SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_7d FROM tx_raw172e9e_1 t JOIN fx_raw172e9e_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency) SELECT row_id || ',' || account_id || ',' || CAST(event_time AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(amount_usd AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(is_weekend AS varchar) || ',' || CAST(amount_7d AS varchar) AS line FROM base" --json 2>/dev/null > .tmp/lines.json

tool_input.description: Build CSV from Trino-emitted lines
